_about: Robert Baker Girdlestone (1836-1923), Synonyms of the Old Testament, first edition (London: Longmans, Green, 1871); from Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title, edition and imprint read from each scan's title page, 2026-11-03.
